import random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/deps')
import networkx as nx
rng = random.Random(7)
nreq, noff = 4096, 8192
pairs = set()
while len(pairs) < 262144:
    pairs.add((rng.randrange(nreq), rng.randrange(noff)))
G = nx.DiGraph()
for i in range(4):
    G.add_edge('@s', ('rq',i), capacity=1024, weight=0)
for i in range(nreq):
    G.add_edge(('rq', rng.randrange(4)), ('r',i), capacity=1, weight=0)
for j in range(noff):
    G.add_edge(('o',j), ('oq', rng.randrange(4)), capacity=4096, weight=0)
for i in range(4):
    G.add_edge(('oq',i), '@t', capacity=4096, weight=0)
costs = [rng.randrange(0, 10**9) for _ in range(noff)]
for i, j in pairs:
    G.add_edge(('r',i), ('o',j), capacity=1, weight=costs[j])
BIG = 4096*10**9 + 1
G.add_edge('@t', '@s', capacity=4096, weight=-BIG)
for n in G.nodes: G.nodes[n]['demand'] = 0
t = time.time()
fl = nx.min_cost_flow(G, demand='demand', capacity='capacity', weight='weight')
dt = time.time() - t
assigned = sum(fl.get(('r',i), {}).get(('o',j), 0) for i, j in pairs)
total_cost = sum(fl.get(('r',i), {}).get(('o',j), 0) * costs[j] for i, j in pairs)
print(f'circulation trick: assigned={assigned} cost={total_cost} time={dt:.2f}s')
EOF
